svg.text: Huge slab, lever switch, glass dome painted black
⚠ Monster on slab & Dracula bat in dome
Kick football → dome breaks → sunlight enters
Circular staircase up, stone wall east
Dark room S, hall W, room N
One loose brick in the east wall...
Pull brick in upper hall to reveal
Flush again → spin back to bathroom
Collapse reveals path to back hall
Foyer S, hall W, library E, stairs N
Central hub of the ground floor
"YOU WON'T GET OUT BY A DOOR"
• Jump on stairs to collapse them → back hall access
• Turn the Homer bust to open the secret bookcase
• Pull the loose brick to open the stone wall
• Give candy to the monster → opens bar
• Kick football through dome → sunlight kills Dracula
• Drop mattress from balcony before jumping!
• Sit on toilet, flush → secret backroom with jade
"You feel a chill run down your spine,
and you doubt your own sanity."
834 production rules ~ 6,744 lines of OPS5 ~ John Laird, 1979-1983
